rules.R-DEADLINE: Deadline: early band (1-30 days late) 10th business day after today; late band (31-90) 5th business day after today capped at the last business day of the current month; holidays skipped.
rules.R-FLOOR: Floor = 10%/25%/50% of past_due (card/personal loan/car loan), rounded up to a multiple of 0.05 euro, at least 20.00 euro, or past_due when that is below 20.00.
rules.R-BDAY: Promises only on Monday-Friday that are not Orvane Bank holidays.
rules.R-CENTS: get_account amounts are euros with cents; create_promise takes integer cents.
rules.R-LADDER: After the opening full-today ask (not counted), steps: full on today+7 (moved off non-business days, capped at deadline), half on deadline, floor on deadline (late only); a step repeating an earlier proposal (opening included) is skipped but still counts toward the limit (early 2, late 3).
rules.R-FAIL: create_promise failing twice: close no_promise/service_error, no note.
rules.R-MOVE: A customer date on a non-business day moves to the next business day; if that is after the deadline, the deadline is used.
